comparison.objective: Wrap and hook a chain to restrain an upright gas cylinder; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop and verifies its motion.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable-chain routing and hook engagement while protecting a cylinder versus coaxial screw/nut tool use with countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a snug hooked chain, safe cylinder attitude, release, and a 10 N restraint test; candidate requires angle tolerance, nut retention, repeated cycles, drift control, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Both include hands-off retention testing, but the tested manipulation is chain routing and restraint rather than coupled screw-and-jam-nut adjustment.
